chain_words.nuance: barely perceptible, hard to see or hear
delicate and hard to notice without attention
clearly visible enough to be seen
standing out so that people cannot miss it
so obvious that it is embarrassing or unacceptable

explanation: These words all describe how easily something can be perceived, from barely detectable to impossible to miss.

usage_notes.difference: 'Faint' describes something weak in strength, such as a sound or smell; 'subtle' describes something delicate or carefully hidden in its effect.
